notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
Welcome to Theta and Paralldox on Worldline Steam Demo! 

It contains about 30 levels in Chapter 0,1,2, and something mysterious.
In order to quickly showcase the highlights of this game, the demo version has streamlined a portion of the first chapter's content. You can look forward to experiencing even more challenging levels in the official release!
